claims: NASA's Artemis II mission is targeted to launch on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
Artemis II mission has a two-hour launch window opening at 6:24 p.m. EDT (2224 GMT).
Artemis II mission will launch from Launch Pad 39B, Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
Artemis II mission's launch vehicle is Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Artemis II mission will send four astronauts around the moon.
Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission.
Additional launch windows for Artemis II mission are available through April 6.
